children: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd has acquired 100% of Bluewater Learning, LLC, a strategic learning and talent transformation partner that helps organizations connect workforce capabilities, learning ecosystems, and technology investments to business priorities. The acquisition has been completed through NIIT Learning’s wholly owned subsidiary, NIIT (USA), Inc., for an aggregate consideration of up to $17.6 million, including performance-based earnouts over the next five years, subject to certain customary adjustments in accordance with the definitive agreements.

According to market buzz, Sagility B.V., promoter of Sagility India, is planning to sell a 12% stake in the company through a block deal, worth around ₹2,377 crore. The shares are likely to be offloaded by Netherlands-based Sagility BV at ₹42.45 apiece, representing a 5% discount to Thursday’s closing price.

The Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM) on Thursday said the second round of bidding for strategic disinvestment of IDBI Bank was conducted under a procedure determined by the Core Group of Secretaries on Disinvestment (CGD), which was empowered by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) to address procedural issues and deviations.

The initial round of bidding was conducted in the financial year 2025-26, but the bids were not approved, following which the first round became functus officio, or ceased to have further effect, the DIPAM said in a statement. It added that the reserve price was neither reduced nor increased and the procedure for the second round, also referred to as the best offer round, was determined by the CGD.

Rail Vikas Nigam Limited has received LOA worth Rs 55 lakh from Ministry of External Affairs for “Preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for Setting up of ‘Professional and Technical Education Centre’ (PTEC) in Seychelles.”

OnMobile Global has entered into a strategic distribution partnership with Savex Technologies, one of India’s leading ICT distributors, to expand the availability of ONMO+ Smart Console across physical retail, e-commerce and quick commerce channels in India. The partnership marks an important step in the company’s plans to establish ONMO+ as a category-defining consumer gaming product.

NBCC (India) has successfully sold residential apartments of approximately 8.80 lac sq. ft area at Avenue Towers, Africa Avenue Marg Sarojini Nagar, New Delhi through an e-auction at total sale value of approximately Rs 5,191 crore. NBCC will get marketing fee of 1% of the sale value. The average sale rate is nearly 60 per cent more than the reserve price of Rs 37,161 per sq ft. The highest bid is Rs 89,061 per sq ft.
